 Position : .NET DEVELOPER 
 Location : CARBON DRIVE PITTSBURG,PA

 REQUIRED SKILLS: 
 • 3+ years development lifecycle experience, including requirements definition, process mapping, detail design, development, testing, delivery, post-implementation support

 • 3+ years experience in database development using MS SQL Server (2005, 2008, 2008 R2)
 • 1+ years MS SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) development experience.
 Required Tasks:
 

 • Highly proficient with VBScript, JavaScript/Ajax, HTML, Microsoft Expression Studio 
 • Proficient to support applications built on Classic ASP (using VB) Proficient with web performance analysis & tuning, and demonstrated ability to troubleshoot system & applications issues.
 • Experience with a project management methodology, issue tracking systems (e.g. BMC Footprints) and version control systems (e.g. SVN).
 • Proficient with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Project. Good knowledge and proficiency with MS Access.
